title: Business Gold Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Businesses
summary: This document explains the Business Gold Rewards Card referral program: earn $200 per successful referral (approved and meeting qualifying spend) with a maximum of 8 bonuses per calendar year. The referred business must spend $7,500 within 90 days of account opening, and referrals are accepted until 2025-09-15.
faqs: How much is the referral bonus for each approved business referral?
What is the maximum number of referral bonuses I can earn per calendar year?
What qualifying spend do I need the referred business to complete, and by when?
Until what date can new referrals be submitted to be eligible?
How do I generate and share my referral link, and where can I track status?
Are self-referrals allowed, and can referrals be credited if they don’t use my link?
